mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and GDP growth indicates a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.0% signals reduced liquidity that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total non-farm payrolls signals weakening labor demand that reduces consumer spending confidence, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 indicates slowing manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 110, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales and housing starts signals broad-based consumer sector weakness that triggers equity market corrections, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When both RSAFS and HOUST decline, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a CPIAUCSL index above 210 signals accelerating inflation from economic stabilization, which supports positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, when CPIAUCSL > 210, the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
